pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Standing with His Arms Crossed Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow the Hedgehog stands with his arms crossed in this printable coloring page, looking forward beneath lowered brows with his large air shoes set apart. His swept quills, outlined head stripe, tufted chest, and thick wrist rings define the figure against a mostly open background on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Holding a Chaos Emerald Coloring Page
pages.description: Shadow the Hedgehog holds a Chaos Emerald in this printable coloring page, cupping the faceted gem between both gloved hands at chest height. His pointed quills and broad head stripe rise above the central jewel, while distinct ankle cuffs and angular air shoes finish the full-body pose.

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Racing Along a Ring Trail with His Air Shoes Coloring Page

pages.title: Shadow the Hedgehog Facing Sonic in a Rival Showdown Coloring Page
